style.base: A cartoon illustration in a friendly, warm art style with bold outlines and soft coloring. Home setting, Uganda. NO TEXT ON IMAGE.
style.home: Traditional elements within modern home - grandmother's cherished items
style.emotions: Accident → fear → hiding → guilt → confession → forgiveness
style.lighting: Bright accident moment, dark guilt scenes, warm forgiveness

sanyu.expressions: Playful → horrified → hiding guilt → sleepless → tearful confession → relief

jjajja.expressions: Confused when pot missing → forgiving and proud when Sanyu confesses

cover.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. A beautiful round clay pot (cracked with gold repair - kintsugi style). Sanyu's face showing mix of regret and hope. Theme of honesty and forgiveness. Title 'The Broken Pot' at top. NO other text.

page-01.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Establishing shot: Jjajja's special clay pot on a high shelf. Round, beautiful, old. Light catches it. 'This pot is very very old' atmosphere. Precious heirloom. NO TEXT.

page-02.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Rainy day outside (visible through window). Sanyu playing INSIDE (not supposed to). Bouncing a ball. Carefree. Bounce. Bounce. The pot on shelf in background. NO TEXT.

page-03.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. CRASH! The pot lies in pieces on the floor. Time frozen. Sanyu's face: absolute horror. Hands over mouth. Shattered pieces. What has she done? Rain still falling outside. NO TEXT.

page-04.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Footsteps coming! Quickly, Sanyu sweeps pieces under shelf with hands. Puts a cloth over empty spot. Panic. Hiding the evidence. Mercy enters, Sanyu pretends to read a book. NO TEXT.

page-05.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Evening. Jjajja notices empty spot. 'Where is my pot?' Confused, not angry. Sanyu's heart POUNDS. 'I don't know.' The lie sticks in throat. Family looking around. NO TEXT.

page-06.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Everyone asks Sanyu if she saw anything. 'No.' Another lie. Mercy looks at Sanyu with questioning eyes. Sanyu can't meet anyone's gaze. The weight begins. NO TEXT.

page-07.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Night. Sanyu in bed, CANNOT sleep. Eyes wide open. Lie pressing on chest like heavy blanket. She sees the broken pieces in her mind. Guilt consuming. NO TEXT.

page-08.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Next day, long and heavy. Every time Jjajja speaks, Sanyu flinches. She can't play, can't eat. Guilt follows her everywhere. Haunted expression. No peace. NO TEXT.

page-09.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu walks slowly to Jjajja. Hands behind back. Eyes on floor. Finally speaks: 'Jjajja... I broke your pot. I was playing inside. I'm sorry. I lied.' Shaking. Confession. NO TEXT.

page-10.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Jjajja is quiet for a moment. Then reaches out, pulls Sanyu close into embrace. 'The pot can be replaced. Your honest heart cannot. I am proud of you for telling truth.' Forgiveness. NO TEXT.

page-11.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu crying into Jjajja's dress. But these are different tears - light tears, relief tears. The stone in her chest is gone. She feels FREE. Weight lifted. NO TEXT.

page-12.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Later: Sanyu helping Jjajja glue the pot back together. Visible cracks now - but beautiful. Jjajja smiles. 'Now it tells a story. The story of a girl who chose truth.' Redemption. NO TEXT.
